text: This report addresses an appeal concerning one variance sought for a first party illuminated wall sign displaying static copy (the "Proposed Sign"). Desiree Norlock of CRIIIP (the "Applicant") applied for the Proposed Sign, which is a wall sign in the form of a logo or corporate symbol, located on the mechanical penthouse of the south elevation on the ten storey office building located at the property municipally known as 1500 Don Mills Road (the "Premises"). After conducting a review in accordance with the requirements of the Sign By-law, a decision was made to refuse to grant the necessary variance. Subsequently, Assunta Tortis of 411 Local Search Corp. (the "Appellant") appealed the decision. It has been determined that there was not enough information provided in the application to establish that the Proposed Sign meets all nine established criteria as contained in §694-30A of the…

The Sign Variance Committee: 1. Granted the requested variance for the Proposed Sign at the premises municipally known as 1500 Don Mills Road, as described in Attachment 1 of the report (March 5, 2016) from the Manager, Sign By-law Unit, Toronto Building.
